title: 23 你们砍人的速度太慢了24 曹笔的刀寡妇的腰
content_zh:
翌日，傍晚。
夕阳西斜，官道蜿蜒向前。
七八辆马车排成一列，护卫们骑马跟在两侧，队伍不紧不慢地走着。
一天的奔波，人困马乏。
队伍中间那辆马车里，曹笔靠在车厢壁上，闭着眼睛。
七十多倍的感知，让周围几百丈内的一切，都清晰得像刻在他脑子里。
护卫们的呼吸声，马匹偶尔的喷鼻声，风吹过树梢的沙沙声，路边草丛里野兔的心跳声……都纤毫毕现！
然后他感知到了一些别的东西。
前方三百米外，官道拐角处，两边的林子里，藏着人。
不少！
呼吸粗重，心跳杂乱，带着一种压抑不住的兴奋。
曹笔的嘴角微微翘了一下。
又来活了！
他默默在心里算了一笔账。
六十多个人，平均属性按一算，那就是六十多点属性。
这要是放跑了，跟丢了一百块钱有什么区别？
……
马车继续往前走。
三百米，两百米，一百米！
“停！”

车队转过拐角，一声暴喝，二十多个汉子从林子里冲出来，堵住了官道。
紧接着，林子里又钻出三十多个，把马车围得严严实实。
六十几号人，清一色的破衣烂衫，手里拿着刀枪棍棒，有的连刀都没有，拿的是锄头镰刀。
为首的是个疤脸大汉，左脸一道刀疤从眼角拉到嘴角，笑起来狰狞得很。
他的目光扫过那些马车，眼睛越来越亮。
“妈的！”
他舔了舔嘴唇：“发了！这回真发了！”
身后的小喽啰们也跟着笑，笑声粗野，眼睛盯着那些马车，像饿狼盯着肉。
一个瘦猴似的小头目凑上来，压低声音：“老大，你看那些马车，那木头，那轮子，一看就是大户人家的，里面肯定有货！”
疤脸大汉点点头，眯着眼打量着车队。
护卫们已经拔出刀，挡在马车前面。
锦袍公子策马上前，脸色平静，拱了拱手。
“诸位好汉，我等路过此地，若有惊扰之处，还望行个方便。”
“行方便？哈哈！”
疤脸大汉哈哈大笑：“行啊！”
content_en:
The next day, evening.
The sun sets in the west, and the official road winds forward.
Seven or eight carriages were lined up in a row, with guards on horseback following on both sides. The team walked leisurely.
After a day of running around, we were exhausted.
In the carriage in the middle of the team, Cao Bi was leaning against the wall of the carriage with his eyes closed.
With more than seventy times the perception, everything within a few hundred feet around him was as clear as if it were engraved in his mind.
The breathing of the guards, the occasional snort of the horses, the rustle of the wind blowing through the treetops, the heartbeat of the hare in the grass on the roadside... they are all revealed in detail!
Then he sensed something else.
Three hundred meters ahead, at the corner of the official road, there were people hiding in the woods on both sides.
Quite a few!
His breathing was heavy, his heartbeat was erratic, and he was filled with uncontrollable excitement.
The corners of Cao Bi's mouth curled up slightly.
Live again!
He silently made a calculation in his mind.
For more than sixty people, the average attribute is more than sixty points.
If you let him go, what's the difference between losing a hundred yuan?
…
The carriage continued to move forward.
Three hundred meters, two hundred meters, one hundred meters!
"Stop!"
As the convoy turned the corner, there was a loud shout and more than twenty men rushed out of the woods and blocked the official road.
Immediately afterwards, more than thirty people emerged from the woods and surrounded the carriage tightly.
There were more than sixty people, all dressed in rags, holding swords, guns and sticks in their hands. Some of them didn't even have knives, but held hoes and sickles.
The leader was a big man with a scarred face. A scar stretched from the corner of his eye to the corner of his mouth on the left side of his face. He smiled very ferociously.
His eyes swept across the carriages, and his eyes became brighter and brighter.
"Damn it!"
He licked his lips: "It's done! It's really done this time!"
The minions behind him also laughed, their laughter was rough, and their eyes were staring at the carriages, like hungry wolves staring at meat.
A skinny monkey-like little boss came up and lowered his voice: "Boss, look at those carriages, the wood, and the wheels. They look like they belong to a wealthy family. There must be something in them!"
The scarred man nodded and looked at the convoy with squinted eyes.
The guards had drawn their swords and stood in front of the carriage.
Young Master Jinpao rode forward with a calm expression on his face and cupped his hands.
"Everyone, we are passing by this place. If there is any disturbance, we hope to make it easier."
"Is that convenient? Haha!"
The scar-faced man laughed loudly: "Okay!"
